items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: she come backstage and go Duke, said Duke, I want you to meet some friends of mine... so Duke went out and met her

ctx.x: She was big, so one night she come up there with Lady Mountbatten, Lord Louis Mountbatten was a big man, an Englishman, he was Lord Louis Mountbatten. During the war he was in charge of a whole fleet, so he was a big man, one of the biggest and she was a cousin of the Queen, Lady Mountbatten was.

So Sophie, she was visiting in the United States and she was a friend of Sophie Tucker, because Sophie had played in Europe, and Sophie had brought her up because when you come to New York, if you didn't go to the Cotton Club, you hadn't seen New York, so she brought her to the Cotton Club.
